description: Expected outcomes of the pinned Morphir conformance cases for the v3 and v4 codec bundles. IDs are stable. "root" and "profile" name the Smithy root shape (model/*.smithy) and profile that check a case. "input" is a JSON pointer, relative to "pointer", to the input value when the case is a corpus entry. "output" names the expected canonical output: the case itself, another case, the file, or literal JSON text. "gap" names a COVERAGE.md gap for a case the bundle does not pass yet. expected is valid (decode and re-encode to the canonical fence), invalid (refuse with the diagnostic) or other-node (decodes as expectNode, not as the case node). Only JSON and text fences are listed; YAML fences, document trees, support-table parsing and filesystem naming cases are out of scope. Run mise run morphir:codecs:vendor -- --check to verify every file, line, fence, pointer and lexeme.
